triage.assessment: ELF inspection proves /usr/bin/caddy is static and has no DT_NEEDED native libraries. The configured process is Caddy and its Compose healthcheck invokes wget, not curl. triage.recommendedAction: Use vendor Alpine package security rebuilds when available. Reopen if scripts/plugins begin invoking curl or native decoders; do not suppress raw package flags.
